note: What a server sends once a client has said which build it runs: whether the two agree, which map to load, who is at the match, and everything else settled before play.

bits.name: buildMatches
bits.note: Set where the client's build is one the server serves.

bits.name: matched
bits.note: Set where the match was put together rather than made by hand.

bits.name: reportingReady
bits.note: Set where the reporting settings below are to be used.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A server leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.

fields.name: map
fields.note: Which map to load. spec/movement.md keys the path origins by the same maps.

fields.name: seats
fields.note: Every place at the match, held or empty.

fields.name: build
fields.note: Which build the server serves. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: mode
fields.note: Which way the match is played, written and padded as above.

fields.name: platform
fields.note: Which platform the match belongs to, written and padded as above.

fields.name: variants
fields.note: The variations the match is played under, one place each. A place stands empty where none applies.

items.name: variant
items.note: One variation. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: variantCount
fields.note: How many of the places above are filled.

fields.name: teamName
fields.note: What one side is called where it plays as a standing team, written and padded as above.

fields.name: teamTag
fields.note: The short form of that name, written and padded as above.

fields.name: otherTeamName
fields.note: What the other side is called, under the same terms.

fields.name: otherTeamTag
fields.note: The short form of that one.

fields.name: metricsHost
fields.note: Where a client reports figures about the match, written and padded as above.

fields.name: metricsPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: metricsPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: reportingHost
fields.note: Where a client reports how the match went, written and padded as above.

fields.name: reportingPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: reportingPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: altReportingHost
fields.note: A second such place, written and padded as above.

fields.name: altReportingPath
fields.note: What it asks for there, written and padded as above.

fields.name: altReportingPort
fields.note: Which port it reaches that at.

fields.name: tip
fields.note: Which note the client shows before play.

fields.name: tipColour
fields.note: Which colouring it shows it in.

fields.name: tipDuration
fields.note: How long it holds it up.

fields.name: tipFlags
fields.note: How else it shows it. The bits within are undetermined.

fields.name: features
fields.note: Which parts of the match are turned on. The bits within are undetermined.

fields.name: disabledItems
fields.note: Items nobody may buy in this match, one place each. A place holds zero where nothing is barred.

items.name: item
items.note: One item, by the number the client knows it as.

fields.name: reportingMessages
fields.note: Which of the reports a client sends are wanted, one place each.
